title: Reference chunk
description: One piece of an imported document, as stored in Cosmos (D42, D43). It informs findings and can't create one, because it isn't a team's decision. A team's rules use corpus-frontmatter.schema.json instead.

id.description: Stable for one place in one document, whatever its text. The prefix is how the evidence check knows a finding cited a reference.

corpus_version.description: Which index this belongs to. Retrieval only reads the version marked complete, so a review never sees a half-built one (D44).

source.description: Which entry in corpus/sources.yml this came from.

source_url.description: The document at that exact commit, for attribution and for checking what a suggestion drew on.

license.description: Only licences that allow this use. Anything else can't be stored (D41).

attribution.description: What to show wherever this text is quoted or a suggestion draws on it.

heading.description: The section within the document, empty for text before its first heading.

provider_version.description: Only on provider docs. A review filters on the version in the repo's lock file, and a version that isn't indexed gets no provider docs.

applies_to.description: Provider resource types this is about. Empty when it isn't about particular ones, which only vector search can find.

text.description: Upstream text, which is untrusted: it stays in its own fence in a prompt.

content_hash.description: Of the text, embedding model and chunker version, so only what changed gets embedded again (D44).

embedding.description: Added by indexing. text-embedding-3-small returns 1536 numbers.
